svg.title: Figure 2: BIE duration trends and signed EER differences
svg.desc: Outlined export of the editable TeX source. Panel A: BIE EER for three enrollment/probe schedules, 300/d, d/60 and d/d seconds. Panel B: stacked CNN minus BIE EER in percentage points; positive favors BIE. Eighteen schedule positions reuse fifteen unique saved conditions. Two primary cells are outlined; other differences are descriptive, not significance claims. No fitted curves or new statistical analysis.
